exchanges#advance-exchanges.context: This chunk comes from the Exchanges Policy document of the Larkspur online store and covers advance exchanges, a benefit available only to Larkspur Plus members, in which the replacement ships before the original item is returned and a card hold is placed that is charged if the original isn't received within 21 days.

exchanges#exchange-window.context: This chunk is from the Exchanges Policy of the online store's customer-support documents, and it covers the exchange window: items can be swapped for a different size or color of the same product within 45 days of delivery, which is longer than the 30-day return window, while swapping for a different product is not allowed.

exchanges#how-exchanges-work.context: This chunk is from the Exchanges Policy of the online store's customer-support documents and explains the step-by-step process for starting an exchange through the Returns Portal, including the free prepaid return label and free shipping both ways on an item's first exchange.

exchanges#limits.context: This chunk comes from the "Exchanges Policy" document of the online store's customer-support policies and covers the limits on exchanges: each item may be exchanged only once, and any further change to the replacement must be handled as a refund under the Returns Policy followed by a new order.

exchanges#out-of-stock-replacements.context: This chunk comes from the Exchanges Policy document and covers what happens when the requested size or color is unavailable, namely store credit or a refund to the original payment method instead of holding the exchange open for a restock.

exchanges#price-differences.context: This chunk comes from the Exchanges Policy of the online store's customer-support documents and covers how price differences are handled when an item is exchanged for a replacement of different cost: a higher-priced replacement requires paying the difference up front, while a lower-priced one results in a refund of the difference to the original payment method.

exchanges#what-can-be-exchanged.context: This chunk comes from the "Exchanges Policy" document of the online store's customer-support policies and covers eligibility rules for exchanges, specifying the condition items must be in, which product types are excluded (final-sale, gift cards, personalized items), and the narrow conditions under which electronics can be exchanged.

membership#cancelling-a-membership.context: This chunk is from the "Cancelling a membership" section of the Larkspur Plus Membership policy document, explaining how and when members can cancel their annual or monthly plans, including refund eligibility, the 30-day full-refund window for annual plans, and the rules for free-trial cancellations.

membership#early-access.context: This chunk is from the Larkspur Plus Membership policy document and covers the early access benefit, explaining that members get seasonal sales 24 hours ahead of the public and member-only deals posted on the first Monday of each month.

membership#household-sharing.context: This chunk comes from the Larkspur Plus Membership policy document and explains the household sharing rules, which let a member extend shipping and returns benefits to one other person at the same address while keeping rewards credit and the extended electronics warranty with the account holder only.

membership#plans-and-pricing.context: This chunk is from the Larkspur Plus Membership policy document and covers the membership's plans and pricing: the annual and monthly costs, the one-time 30-day free trial, and automatic renewal.

membership#shipping-and-returns-benefits.context: This chunk comes from the Larkspur Plus Membership policy document and covers the shipping and returns perks members receive, including free 2-day shipping, free return labels, extended return windows for most items and electronics, and member-only advance exchanges.

membership#warranty-and-rewards-benefits.context: This chunk is from the "Larkspur Plus Membership" policy document and covers the warranty and rewards benefits, explaining the extra year of electronics warranty for members and the 5% Larkspur Rewards credit, including its 12-month expiry and restrictions.

payment#accepted-payment-methods.context: This chunk is from the Larkspur Supply "Payment Policy" document and covers the accepted payment methods at checkout, including cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Larkspur gift cards and Klarna, along with the payment types not accepted (checks, money orders, cash on delivery, cryptocurrency, wire transfers) and notes on US-dollar pricing and foreign card fees.

payment#failed-payments.context: This chunk is from the Larkspur Supply Payment Policy and covers what happens when a payment fails at shipping time, such as an expired card: the customer is emailed, the order is held for 48 hours, and it is cancelled automatically if the payment method is not updated.

payment#gift-cards.context: This chunk is from the "Payment Policy" document of the Larkspur Supply online store and covers the Gift cards section: that Larkspur gift cards never expire or carry fees, how many can be used per order, what they cannot be used for, and how lost or stolen cards are replaced.

payment#payment-security.context: This chunk comes from the Larkspur Supply Payment Policy and covers payment security: how card numbers are encrypted and handled by the payment processor rather than stored by Larkspur, and the rule that support staff will never request full card numbers, security codes or passwords through chat, email or phone.

payment#sales-tax.context: This chunk is from Larkspur Supply's "Payment Policy" document and covers how sales tax is determined on orders, based on the shipping address rather than the billing address, and how tax-exempt organizations can request an exemption certificate before ordering.

privacy#accessing-and-exporting-your-dat.context: This chunk is from the Privacy Policy of Larkspur's online store and covers how customers can request an export of the personal data the store holds about them, including where to submit the request and the 30-day delivery timeline after identity verification.

privacy#deleting-your-data.context: This chunk comes from the "Deleting your data" section of Larkspur's Privacy Policy, explaining how customers can request deletion of their account and personal data, the 45-day completion window after identity verification, and which order and payment records must be retained by law and are excluded from marketing use.

refunds#when-a-refund-is-issued.context: This chunk comes from the Refunds Policy document and explains when a refund is issued after a returned item reaches the warehouse, including the 2-business-day inspection window, the 3-business-day refund timeline, and why the refund date depends on inspection rather than the shipping date.

refunds#where-refunds-go.context: This chunk is from the Refunds Policy document and covers where refund money is sent, explaining that refunds return to the original payment method, when they become store credit instead (closed or returned cards, gift card purchases), and why refunds cannot go to a different card, bank account, or person.

returns#holiday-returns.context: This chunk comes from the "Returns Policy" document of the online store's customer-support policies and covers the extended holiday return window: purchases made November 15 to December 24 may be returned until January 31 of the following year, with electronics and final-sale items excluded.

returns#how-to-start-a-return.context: This chunk from the "Returns Policy" document of the online store's customer-support policies explains the first step of the return process: starting a return in the Returns Portal, obtaining an RMA number, and the 14-day deadline for dropping off the package, with packages lacking an RMA number refused at the warehouse.

returns#items-that-cannot-be-returned.context: This chunk comes from the "Returns Policy" document for the online store and covers the list of items that cannot be returned or exchanged, such as final-sale clearance goods, gift cards, personalized items, perishables, and opened personal-care products, noting that final-sale items remain under warranty if defective.

shipping#damaged-deliveries.context: This chunk is from the Shipping Policy's "Damaged deliveries" section, explaining that customers must report a damaged package within 48 hours of delivery with photos, and what remedies (replacement or refund including shipping) and packaging-retention requirements apply.
